MOEV-0000 Add frame analysis overlay feature

Implemented frame-level video segment analysis using mp4box.js:

- Added FrameAnalyzerService to parse MP4/fMP4 segments and extract frame metadata
- Created FrameOverlayComponent with visual timeline showing I-frames vs P/B-frames
- Added toggle button in icon-bar to show/hide frame overlay
- Displays frame statistics: total frames, keyframes, GOP size, duration
- Shows detailed frame table with PTS, DTS, size, and type
- Integrated into manifest-viewer component
- Added showFrameOverlay flag to ViewerState and ViewerOptionTypes

Key features:
- Visual frame timeline with color-coded bars \(green=I-frames, gray=P/B-frames\)
- Supports MP4/fMP4 segments \(DASH streams\)
- Error handling for fetch failures and unsupported formats
- MPEG-TS support planned for future iteration

Dependencies:
- Added mp4box package for segment parsing

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
MOEV-0000 Add MPEG-TS support, auto-detection, and real-time timeline

Implemented three major enhancements to frame analysis:

1. MPEG-TS Support:
   - Added mux.js package for MPEG-TS transmuxing
   - Enhanced FrameAnalyzerService to detect container types \(MP4 vs TS\)
   - Auto-transmuxes MPEG-TS to fMP4 before analyzing with mp4box.js
   - Updated UI to display container type in analysis results

2. Auto-Detection of Segment URLs:
   - Hooks into HLS fragment events \(fragLoaded$, fragLoading$, fragChanged$\)
   - Hooks into DASH fragment events \(dashFragLoading$, dashFragLoaded$\)
   - Automatically captures current segment URL from player events
   - Updates currentSegmentUrl property in manifest-viewer component
   - Enables frame overlay to analyze the actively playing segment

3. Real-Time Video Timeline:
   - Created FrameTimelineComponent with visual playback timeline
   - Shows frame markers color-coded by type \(green=I-frames, gray=P/B\)
   - Displays red playhead tracking current video position
   - Highlights currently playing frame with blue marker
   - Click timeline to seek to specific frames
   - Synchronized with video playback via currentDisplayTime$ observable
   - Shares frame data between components via BehaviorSubject

Technical improvements:
   - Added currentFrameData$ BehaviorSubject to FrameAnalyzerService
   - Both frame-overlay and frame-timeline components share analysis results
   - Automatic frame position tracking based on PTS timestamps
   - Supports click-to-seek functionality

Key features:
   - Works with both MP4/fMP4 \(DASH\) and MPEG-TS \(HLS\) segments
   - Zero-configuration auto-detection of segment format
   - Real-time visual feedback during video playback
   - Frame-accurate seeking and navigation

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
MOEV-0000 Add comprehensive frame analysis UI enhancements

Enhanced the frame analysis overlay and timeline components with advanced
features for better video segment inspection and navigation.

Features Added:

1. Auto-Analyze on Segment Change:
   - Toggle switch to enable/disable auto-analysis
   - Debounced segment change detection \(500ms\)
   - Segment counter showing number of analyzed segments
   - Analysis history tracking \(last 10 segments\)

2. GOP \(Group of Pictures\) Visualization:
   - Interactive bar chart showing GOP structure
   - Visual representation of GOP sizes
   - Hover effects and tooltips
   - GOP count and statistics

3. Export and Copy Features:
   - Export frame data as JSON with download button
   - Copy frame analysis summary to clipboard
   - Includes GOP structure in export data
   - Frame rate calculation

4. Enhanced Loading States:
   - Improved loading indicator with spinner
   - Multi-line loading text \(title + subtitle\)
   - Animated indeterminate progress bar
   - Better visual feedback during analysis

5. Frame-by-Frame Navigation:
   - Previous/Next frame buttons
   - Jump to previous/next I-frame \(keyframe\)
   - Smart button disable states
   - Keyboard-friendly navigation controls
   - Material Design icons

6. Enhanced Statistics:
   - Frame rate calculation from PTS timestamps
   - Bitrate estimation
   - Duration formatting

Technical Implementation:
- Added OnChanges lifecycle hook for segment URL detection
- RxJS Subject with debounceTime for change throttling
- GOP calculation algorithm for frame grouping
- Navigation helper methods with boundary checking
- CSS animations for progress bars and interactions
- Responsive layout with flexbox

Files Modified:
- frame-overlay.component.ts: Auto-analyze, export, GOP calculation
- frame-overlay.component.html: Toggle, GOP chart, export buttons
- frame-overlay.component.scss: GOP chart, enhanced loading, toggle switch
- frame-timeline.component.ts: Navigation methods and helpers
- frame-timeline.component.html: Navigation control buttons
- frame-timeline.component.scss: Navigation button styles

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
